start.title: [TODO:ar] A New House
start.text:
[TODO:ar] You stand in a stranger's courtyard.
Potiphar, captain of Pharaoh, watches you.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You would be hunted as a runaway.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Bow and serve with all your heart
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You bow low. The Lord is with you.
[TODO:ar] Potiphar laughs coldly. You are a slave.

run_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Nowhere to Go
run_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] The gate is guarded. The desert is wide.
You turn back inside.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You will trust God where He has placed you.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Silence the Pride
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] A guard's hand falls hard on your shoulder.
Pride will not free you.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your knee touches the cool stone.

serve_well.title: [TODO:ar] The Lord Is With You
serve_well.text:
[TODO:ar] Each task you touch prospers.
Potiphar begins to notice.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Steal grain to keep for yourself
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] A slave's hand must be clean.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Give God the glory in silence
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You whisper thanks. Heaven hears.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Boast of your skill to others
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Boasting will draw envy, not favor.

steal_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Your Hand Stops
steal_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] The grain is heavy in your palm.
You cannot betray such trust.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You set it back. Peace returns.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Cold Glances
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] The other servants turn from you.
Your words have made enemies.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Kneel and give God the glory
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Humility softens what pride broke.

trusted.title: [TODO:ar] Set Over All
trusted.text:
[TODO:ar] "All I have is in your hand," Potiphar says.
He makes you steward of his house.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Use the wealth for your comfort
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] His trust is not yours to spend.
[TODO:ar] You take up the scrolls with care.

wealth_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] A Quiet Warning
wealth_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] You feel the weight of his eyes.
Greed will undo you.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You return to your duties.

diligent.title: [TODO:ar] Blessing in the House
diligent.text:
[TODO:ar] The fields, the storehouse, the table — all flourish.
The Lord blesses for your sake.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Pray and thank God each day
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your prayers rise like incense.
[TODO:ar] The blessing is not yours to claim.

credit_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] A Hollow Praise
credit_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Their praise tastes like dust.
God alone deserves the glory.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Pray and give thanks to God
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You bow your head in private.

noticed.title: [TODO:ar] Her Eyes Linger
noticed.text:
[TODO:ar] Potiphar's wife watches you each day.
Her smile is warm, too warm.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] A small flame can burn a house.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Keep your eyes lowered, work on
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You bow your head and pass.

smile_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] She Steps Closer
smile_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Your kindness has been read as want.
This is not the path.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Withdraw and keep your eyes low
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You step back from the fire.

first_advance.title: [TODO:ar] "Lie With Me"
first_advance.text:
[TODO:ar] She whispers it openly. Her hand finds yours.
The room grows still.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Refuse — "How can I sin against God?"
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your voice is firm and quiet.
[TODO:ar] To weigh sin is to invite it.
[TODO:ar] God sees what no man sees.

weigh_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Her Grip Tightens
weigh_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Hesitation is half a yes.
You must speak the truth now.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You pull your hand away.

yield_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] A Voice Inside
yield_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Before her lips meet yours, conscience cries out.
You pull back.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] "I cannot sin against God."

she_persists.title: [TODO:ar] Day After Day
she_persists.text:
[TODO:ar] She speaks to you each morning.
Each evening she waits in the hall.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Wisdom keeps the door shut.
[TODO:ar] Anger may shame her into hatred.
[TODO:ar] Who would believe a slave?

confront_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Her Face Hardens
confront_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Pride wounded turns to spite.
You must walk softly now.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You change your paths in the house.

tell_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] He Cannot Hear It
tell_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Potiphar waves you away, troubled.
A slave's word is small.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Avoid her presence from now on
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You will simply not be near her.

the_empty_house.title: [TODO:ar] No One Within
the_empty_house.text:
[TODO:ar] The servants are gone for the feast.
You enter the hall to do your work.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Be swift. The house is too quiet.
[TODO:ar] Quiet houses are not always safe.

linger_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] A Door Opens
linger_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Soft footsteps in the corridor.
You should have gone.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You turn for the door.

she_grabs.title: [TODO:ar] She Catches Your Garment
she_grabs.text:
[TODO:ar] Her hand closes on your cloak.
"Lie with me!" she demands.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You slip out of the cloth and run.
[TODO:ar] She will tear it and call it proof.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Yield this once to keep peace
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] There is no peace in such a sin.

wrestle_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] The Cloth Tears
wrestle_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] She holds the torn piece, eyes bright.
Do not stay to argue.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You let go and run for the door.

yield2_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] God Sees
yield2_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] His eyes are upon you in this room.
You cannot do this thing.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You break free and run.

fled.title: [TODO:ar] Out Into the Sun
fled.text:
[TODO:ar] You stand outside, breathing hard.
Your cloak is in her hand.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Hide and wait for the truth
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Hiding only looks like guilt.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Return to your duties in faith
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] God knows. You will trust Him.

hide2_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] They Will Find You
hide2_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] A slave cannot hide for long.
Better to walk in the open.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Return to your duties in faith
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You square your shoulders and go.

her_cry.title: [TODO:ar] She Cries Out
her_cry.text:
[TODO:ar] She calls the servants, holding your cloak.
"The Hebrew tried to shame me!"

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your peace will be your defense.
[TODO:ar] Anger will only feed her story.
[TODO:ar] Flight is a confession.

shout_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Their Faces Turn
shout_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Loud denial seems like guilt.
Be still. Trust God.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You close your mouth in peace.

flee_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Soldiers at the Gate
flee_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] You will not outrun Potiphar's guard.
Face this with faith.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You walk back, head bowed.

before_potiphar.title: [TODO:ar] His Wrath Burns
before_potiphar.text:
[TODO:ar] Potiphar holds the torn cloak.
His eyes are dark with anger.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You kneel without a word.
[TODO:ar] His mind is set. Words will not turn it.
[TODO:ar] Such words could cost your head.

beg_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] He Will Not Hear
beg_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Your pleading falls on stone.
Only silence will keep your life.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You lower yourself to the floor.

curse_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] The Guards Step Forward
curse_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Steel rings half from the sheath.
Close your mouth before it costs all.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You drop to your knees in silence.

to_prison.title: [TODO:ar] Bound for the Prison
to_prison.text:
[TODO:ar] Ropes bind your wrists.
They lead you toward the king's prison.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Walk in faith — God is with you
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You lift your eyes to heaven.

ending.title: [TODO:ar] The Lord Was With Him
ending.text:
[TODO:ar] The gates close behind you.
Yet even here, the Lord shows you mercy.
